notes.title: WE'RE RELEASING TOMORROW!
notes.content:
Yes! We can say it out loud![b]🌴INVISIBLE FLOW🌴 is releasing on the 13th of Dec on Steam![/b] Finally you will get to know John, the Lush Palms island’s mysteries and find out about local scientists’ experiments and further consequences 🧪 💨💨💨 Save the date and don't miss! notes.title: INVISIBLE FLOW 3d Trailer is out! Latest upgrades!
notes.content: The ultimate 🏝️INVISIBLE FLOW🏝️ upgrade is here! Since the demo drop, we've been grinding non-stop on our game, and guess what? Graphics overhaul and enhanced gameplay  – now even more stunning! Feel the vibe, see the difference. This all is thanks to your feedback, guys! You drew our attention to aiming and shooting - we worked on this almost the most. We're excited to present you a small part of all the changes in this trailer. This means that the full game launch is around the corner 😉 [previewyoutube=twWEdu8szR4;full][/previewyoutube]
